risks: Food-contact: must be natural/oil (food-safe oil) finish with no lacquer, PU, enamel or paint on the inside; get supplier written confirmation of finish; do not claim 'food grade' or 'food safe' without a test report
Supplier prices are IndiaMART category 'starting from' snippets with no size/wood/MOQ; need a written quote for the exact bowl
UP supplier: website-only (Shopify); 30% needs supplier cost <= ~29% of price (Rs 188 at Rs 649) - Rs 180 leaves almost no headroom; if quote is above ~Rs 188 it fails
Marketplace check not done: if the same supplier or brands sell comparable plain mango wood bowls on Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho below ~Rs 500, the item fails
Wood cracking/warping in dry season and transit dents; care instructions (hand wash, oil) needed to limit returns
Many 'mango wood' listings are acacia/engineered; confirm wood species before claiming
GST: HSN 4419 wooden tableware believed 5% after the 22-09-2025 rate change; CA to confirm

review.notes: Supplier cost Rs 180 is unsupported (IndiaMART category 'from' snippets, no size/wood/MOQ); the only sized IndiaMART price found is Rs 380/piece for a 6 in round mango bowl (MOQ not shown), and export listings show 10.5 in at $7-10/unit, so an 8-10 in bowl single-piece is very likely above the Rs 188 cap the 30% margin needs at Rs 649. No marketplace listing below Rs 649 found (Amazon.in/Meesho returned nothing; flipkart.com/nestasia.in not reachable from this session); food-contact finish still needs written supplier confirmation and no 'food safe' claim without a test report. Reopen only with a written quote <= Rs 188 for the exact size, single-piece drop-ship.
